candidates.locator: Article I — Of Faith in the Holy Trinity
candidates.phrase: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost
candidates.rationale: Names the Father as one of the three co-equal, co-eternal divine persons of one substance in the Godhead.
candidates.chunk_text: There is but one living and true God, everlasting, without body or parts, of infinite power, wisdom, and goodness; the maker and preserver of all things, both visible and invisible. And in unity of this Godhead there are three persons, of one substance, power, and eternity—the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.

candidates.locator: Article II — Of the Word, or Son of God, Who Was Made Very Man
candidates.phrase: who is the Word of the Father, the very and eternal God
candidates.rationale: Identifies the Father as the eternal God to whom the Son relates as Word, affirming divine paternity relationally.
candidates.chunk_text: The Son, who is the Word of the Father, the very and eternal God, of one substance with the Father, took man's nature in the womb of the blessed Virgin; so that two whole and perfect natures, that is to say, the Godhead and Manhood, were joined together in one person, never to be divided; whereof is one Christ, very God and very Man, who truly suffered, was crucified, dead, and buried, to reconcile his Father to us, and to be a sacrifice, not only for original guilt, but also for actual sins of men.

candidates.locator: Article IV — Of the Holy Ghost
candidates.phrase: proceeding from the Father and the Son
candidates.rationale: Asserts the Father's relational identity as the source from whom the Spirit proceeds, within the Godhead.
candidates.chunk_text: The Holy Ghost, proceeding from the Father and the Son, is of one substance, majesty, and glory with the Father and the Son, very and eternal God.

candidates.phrase: the one God reveals himself as the Trinity: Father, Son and Holy Spirit
candidates.rationale: Asserts that the one God is revealed as Father, naming divine paternity as an identity within the Godhead.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe in the one true, holy and living God, Eternal Spirit, who is Creator, Sovereign and Preserver of all things visible and invisible. He is infinite in power, wisdom, justice, goodness and love, and rules with gracious regard for the well-being and salvation of men, to the glory of his name. We believe the one God reveals himself as the Trinity: Father, Son and Holy Spirit, distinct but inseparable, eternally one in essence and power.

candidates.phrase: who proceeds from and is one in being with the Father and the Son
candidates.rationale: Names the Father as a distinct divine person one in being with the Son, affirming relational identity of God.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe in the Holy Spirit who proceeds from and is one in being with the Father and the Son. He convinces the world of sin, of righteousness and of judgment. He leads men through faithful response to the gospel into the fellowship of the Church. He comforts, sustains and empowers the faithful and guides them into all truth.

candidates.phrase: the only begotten Son of the Father
candidates.rationale: Identifies God as Father in relation to the eternal Son, asserting the divine paternal relation.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe in Jesus Christ, truly God and truly man, in whom the divine and human natures are perfectly and inseparably united. He is the eternal Word made flesh, the only begotten Son of the Father, born of the Virgin Mary by the power of the Holy Spirit. As ministering Servant he lived, suffered and died on the cross. He was buried, rose from the dead and ascended into heaven to be with the Father, from whence he shall return. He is eternal Savior and Mediator, who intercedes for us, and by him all men will be judged.

survivors.locator: Article I — Of Faith in the Holy Trinity
survivors.phrase: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost
survivors.rationale: Names the Father as one of the three co-equal, co-eternal divine persons of one substance in the Godhead.
survivors.chunk_text: There is but one living and true God, everlasting, without body or parts, of infinite power, wisdom, and goodness; the maker and preserver of all things, both visible and invisible. And in unity of this Godhead there are three persons, of one substance, power, and eternity—the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.

survivors.phrase: the one God reveals himself as the Trinity: Father, Son and Holy Spirit
survivors.rationale: Asserts that the one God is revealed as Father, naming divine paternity as an identity within the Godhead.
survivors.chunk_text: We believe in the one true, holy and living God, Eternal Spirit, who is Creator, Sovereign and Preserver of all things visible and invisible. He is infinite in power, wisdom, justice, goodness and love, and rules with gracious regard for the well-being and salvation of men, to the glory of his name. We believe the one God reveals himself as the Trinity: Father, Son and Holy Spirit, distinct but inseparable, eternally one in essence and power.
